assertion_results.text: The plan determines feature-branch workflow mode (not direct-to-main) based on the atomicity constraints in the feature description
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md lines 22-35: 'Selected mode: feature-branch' with rationale citing three atomicity indicators: coordinated schema migrations, breaking API changes, and tightly coupled feature components. summary-comment.md line 28: 'Feature-branch mode selected due to atomicity constraints: the database migration and all code changes are tightly coupled.'

assertion_results.text: A bookend task with Bookend Type create-branch is generated as the first task in the plan
assertion_results.evidence: task-1-create-feature-branch.md contains '## Bookend Type\ncreate-branch' (lines 8-9). summary-comment.md table row: 'Task 1 | Create feature branch TC-9005 from main | trustify-backend | Bookend (create-branch)' — listed as the first task.

assertion_results.text: A bookend task with Bookend Type merge-branch is generated as the last task in the plan

assertion_results.evidence: Non-documentation intermediate tasks all list Task 1 as a dependency: Task 2 (line 60: 'Depends on: Task 1'), Task 3 (line 57: 'Depends on: Task 1'), Task 4 (line 63: 'Depends on: Task 1'), Task 5 (line 63: 'Depends on: Task 1'), Task 6 (line 51: 'Depends on: Task 1'). assertion_results.text: The merge-branch bookend task lists all non-documentation intermediate tasks as dependencies
assertion_results.evidence: task-8-merge-feature-branch.md lines 24-29 lists dependencies on Tasks 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 (all non-documentation intermediate tasks) and also Task 7 (documentation). All five non-documentation intermediate tasks are included.

assertion_results.text: Each non-documentation task file contains all required template sections: Repository, Target Branch, Description, at least one of Files to Modify or Files to Create, Implementation Notes, Acceptance Criteria, Test Requirements. Documentation tasks are exempt from requiring Files to Modify, Files to Create, and Implementation Notes — they must still include Repository, Target Branch, Description, Acceptance Criteria, and Test Requirements
assertion_results.evidence: Bookend tasks 1 and 8 are non-documentation task files that lack required sections. task-1-create-feature-branch.md has Repository, Target Branch, Description, Acceptance Criteria, Test Requirements but lacks 'Files to Modify' or 'Files to Create' and 'Implementation Notes'. task-8-merge-feature-branch.md similarly lacks these sections. Implementation tasks 2-6 all contain the full set of required sections. Documentation task 7 correctly includes Repository, Target Branch, Description, Acceptance Criteria, and Test Requirements (exempt from the other sections).

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a priority set (not 'Undefined'), the plan documents that the Feature's priority is inherited by created tasks — evidenced by priority field values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When the Feature's priority is 'Undefined', the plan documents that priority inheritance is skipped (not propagated as null or 'Undefined')
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md line 42: 'Priority: High (inherited from feature TC-9005, propagated to all created tasks)'. summary-comment.md line 34: 'Priority: High — propagated from feature TC-9005 to all created tasks'. The priority is 'High' (not 'Undefined') and is documented as inherited.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a non-empty fixVersions array and the fixVersion scope config (from ### Jira Field Defaults in CLAUDE.md) is 'task' or 'both' (or absent, defaulting to 'both'), the plan documents that fixVersions are inherited by created tasks — evidenced by fixVersion values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When fixVersion scope is 'feature' or the Feature has no fixVersions, the plan documents that fixVersion inheritance is skipped
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md line 43: 'Fix Versions: RHTPA 2.0.0 (inherited from feature TC-9005, propagated to all created tasks; no `fixVersion scope` configured in Jira Field Defaults, defaulting to "both")'. summary-comment.md line 35: 'Fix Versions: RHTPA 2.0.0 — propagated from feature TC-9005 to all created tasks (no `fixVersion scope` setting found in Jira Field Defaults; defaulting to "both", which includes task-level propagation)'. The fixVersion scope is absent (defaults to 'both') and fixVersions are non-empty, so inheritance is correctly documented.

assertion_results.text: A summary of inherited field propagation is produced — evidenced by a summary-comment.md file in the outputs directory, or a summary section in the impact map that includes the inherited priority and fixVersion values propagated to tasks, or states they were omitted and why
assertion_results.evidence: summary-comment.md exists with 'Inherited Field Values' section (lines 33-35) documenting 'Priority: High' and 'Fix Versions: RHTPA 2.0.0' propagated to all created tasks. impact-map.md also has a 'Field Inheritance' section (lines 40-43) with the same information.
